title: Classes supported on a map
statement:
Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, a field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$
and its fixed algebraic closure $k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], and put
$s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension
$E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$,
its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$;
put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, as in
[def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type
$k$-schemes and put $Z=Y\times_s X$ [def-pc-fibre-product], the product
used in [def-trf-correspondence-between-pairs].
Write $D(W,A)$ for the derived category
of sheaves of $A$-modules on the small pro-etale site of $W$, as in
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let
$P\in D(Z,A)$ and let $i:T\to Z$ be a separated finite-type morphism of
separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties],
with compact-support direct image $Ri_!$ as in
[def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] and the coefficient conventions. A *class supported on $i$*
with values in $P$ is an element of

$$
H_T^0(Z,P):=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(Z,A)}\bigl(Ri_!A_T,P\bigr),
$$

where $A_T$ is the constant sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf],
regarded as a complex concentrated in degree zero. The map $i$ is part of the data of
the class: it need not be an immersion, and the group is indexed by the specified map, not merely its image.
No identification of groups is made solely from equality of the images.
